FWP 1 d382225dfwp.htm FWP FWP Pricing Term Sheet Free Writing Prospectus dated as of October 26, 2026 Filed pursuant to Rule 433 Relating to the Preliminary Prospectus Supplements each dated October 26, 2026 to the Prospectus dated October 26, 2026 Registration No. 333-299631 Meta Platforms, Inc. Concurrent Offerings of 40,000,000 Shares of Class A Common Stock, par value $0.000006 per Share (the “Class A Common Stock” and such offering, the “Common Stock Offering”), and 250,000,000 Series A Depositary Shares (the “Series A Depositary Shares”) Each Representing a 1/20th Interest in a Share of 6.50% Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock (the “Series A Depositary Shares Offering”) The information in this pricing term sheet relates only to the Common Stock Offering and the Series A Depositary Shares Offering and should be read together with (i) the preliminary prospectus supplement dated October 26, 2026 relating to the Common Stock Offering (the “ Common Stock Preliminary Prospectus Supplement ”) and (ii) the preliminary prospectus supplement dated October 26, 2026 relating to the Series A Depositary Shares Offering (the “ Series A Depositary Shares Preliminary Prospectus Supplement ”), respectively, in each case including the documents incorporated by reference therein and the related base prospectus dated October 26, 2026. Each preliminary prospectus supplement has been filed, together with the related base prospectus, pursuant to Rule 424(b) under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “ Securities Act ”), Registration No. 333-299631. The closing of the Series A Depositary Shares Offering is not conditioned upon the closing of the Common Stock Offering and the closing of the Common Stock Offering is not conditioned upon the closing of the Series A Depositary Shares Offering. Terms not defined in this pricing term sheet have the meanings given to such terms in the Common Stock Preliminary Prospectus Supplement or the Series A Depositary Shares Preliminary Prospectus Supplement, as applicable. All references to dollar amounts are references to U.S. dollars. Meta Platforms, Inc. has increased the size of the Common Stock Offering to $25.0 billion, consisting of 40,000,000 shares of Class A Common Stock (or 46,000,000 shares of Class A Common Stock if the underwriters in the Common Stock Offering exercise in full their option to purchase additional shares of Class A Common Stock). The final prospectus supplement relating to the Common Stock Offering will reflect conforming changes relating to such increase in the size of the Common Stock Offering. Issuer: Meta Platforms, Inc. Ticker / Exchange for the Class A Common Stock: META / The Nasdaq Global Select Market (“ Nasdaq ”) Pricing Date: October 26, 2026. Trade Date: October 27, 2026 (“T”). Settlement Date for the Common Stock Offering: October 29, 2026 (T+2), which is the second business day following the trade date for the Class A Common Stock (such settlement cycle being referred to as “T+2”).
